aviation_incidents.headline_en: German authorities investigate attempted perimeter breach at Leipzig-Halle airport (LEJ)
aviation_incidents.summary_en: German authorities are investigating an attempt to breach the perimeter of Leipzig-Halle airport (LEJ) in Germany, according to official sources reported on October 18, 2026. According to those reports, a car appears to have rammed through one of the fences protecting the airport perimeter during the night of October 17 to 18, 2026, and driven a few meters inside before fleeing the scene.

international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空已完成空中巴士A340-600最後一班定期載客航班，該機型在漢莎航空的定期載客服務至此結束。LH419於10月18日自Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)出發，前往Frankfurt；這是漢莎航空最後一班由A340-600執行的定期載客航班。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa completes final scheduled A340-600 passenger flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa has operated its final scheduled passenger flight with the Airbus A340-600, ending the type’s scheduled passenger service with the airline. Flight LH419 was the final service, operating from Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) to Frankfurt. The service departed on 18 October.

Aerospace Global News — Lufthansa retires its last Airbus A340-600 after final flig…

new_information: Lufthansa operated its final scheduled passenger flight with the Airbus A340-600.
Lufthansa Airbus A340-600 D-AIHW landed at Frankfurt Airport (FRA) at 6:31am GMT on 19 October.
The final service was flight LH419 from Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD) to Frankfurt.
Sunday, 18 October, marked the official departure of Lufthansa’s last scheduled passenger operations with the Airbus A340-600.
The smaller Airbus A340-300 is expected to remain in service until 2027.
The final flight marked the end of almost 23 years of operations of the type.

international_aviation.headline: 利雅德機場重開 抵離航班須事先獲準
international_aviation.summary: 利雅德的 King Khalid International Airport 於10月18日重開，並在關閉超過一週後恢復營運。重開不代表營運限制全面解除：NOTAM A3650/26規定，所有抵達及離場航空器均須事先取得沙烏地阿拉伯民航總局許可；NOTAM A3651/26則列明，機場不可作為預定備降機場。
international_aviation.headline_en: Riyadh Airport Reopens With Prior Permission Required for All Flights
international_aviation.summary_en: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh reopened on 18 October and resumed operations after more than a week of closure. Restrictions remain in place: NOTAM A3650/26 requires prior permission from Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation for all arriving and departing aircraft. Under NOTAM A3651/26, the airport is unavailable for use as a planned diversion airport.

The airport has resumed limited operations, but several international carriers have extended cancellations into November, while others have postponed services until 2027.
